posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Early-morning game that won't quite finish off Ambuscade. He was taken down in Magmaria by Xtreme Argent Adept, Chrono-Ranger Best of Times, Fused Captain Cosmic and TN AZ. (What a crappy team!) I leave it to someone else to use Xtreme Captain Cosmic.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Why was that such a bad team?

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
TNAZ always takes a while to ramp up, XPWAA's best effect involves him damaging his teammates, Fused CC constantly damages himself, and CRBoT I just can't figure out. I mean, it seems like I just always have bad draws when I'm playing him, but half the time, he has nothing to do.

Like in today's game against the Ennead, which I lost horribly right at the end. D: I actually got his power working somewhat regularly, but to little overall effect.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Wouldn't the Adept's base power since he goes before AZ in this case help with that setup issue?   As to that version of Chrono Ranger the change to me just means you hope to get Bounties out quickly and take advantage of it on multiple targets which that setup should have a good amount of.   For Fused Captain Cosmic just a matter of knowing when to blow up Constucts I really can't wait to play in the video game implementation.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
BoT I think I'll have to see in the game before I can really figure him out. Right now, he seems to be a severe downgrade.

Played a very odd Villains game tonight, trying to go back and forth between game styles while the number of games remaining is fairly close. Hammer and Anvil, Operative, Greazer Clutch, La Capitan and Ambuscade versus Fugue State Parse, Tachyon, Wraith, PW Fanatic and Haka in the Block. Fanatic kind of owned the game by constantly accidentally clearing the board. (Nemeses can't do anything when they're destroyed!) Also, winning strategy: throw the monkey.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: It took two tries, but I finally beat the Ennead with the team of Xtreme Argent Adept, Chrono Ranger BoT, Xtreme Captain Cosmic, Sky-Scraper Extremist and Xtreme Tempest. This time, I leave Fused CC for someone else to try. I may have finally gotten BoT working right, too. <.< That feel when Argent Adept and Captain Cosmic are your best DPS...

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: One more game today! Unstable Kismet versus F5 Tachyon, Setting Sun Ra, Fused Captain Cosmic, Xtreme Haka and Completionist Guise in Magmaria. Found out Completionist Guise has massive synergy with Captain Cosmic. He loves using Requital! Fabrication ain't too shabby, either. The final blow was intense: Ra hits Kismet with Inferno to trigger Inconcievable Obstruction, which brings a Crystalloid Behemoth into play, which then starts killing everything, hitting Kismet down to 2 HP, knocking out the Constructs, letting Captain Cosmic ping Kismet for one, and then hitting Tachyon, who redirects that 4 damage to Kismet for the win. Crazy.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: More Unstable Kismet this morning! Captain Cosmic, Eternal Haka, Unity, Fanatic and F5 Bunker took her down in the Court of Blood. It was a weird game, going pretty well until a Karmic Disjunction revealed five Lucky cards. At which point I said, it's time to use the Talisman for once, and shut her way the heck down for the rest of the game. Mostly because almost nobody got any ongoing destruction. :B

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Filling in some Villains stuff: Advanced Operative, Plague Rat, Miss Info and Sergeant Steel versus Greatest Legacy, KNYFE Rogue Agent, Scholar of the Infinite and Ra in the Final Wasteland. A pretty crazy game, all things considered, and yes I finished with SotI's big Turn Loose combo. :)

posts.name: thrawn.kol
posts.cooked:
Since I've had my Shattered+Cosmos box in hand for two weeks, it's high time I finished my F5 vs. solo villain world tour.

Five games, five wins. Advanced Kismet, Advanced Unstable Kismet, Dreamer, Advanced La Capitan, and Advanced Iron Legacy were no match for the F5's crazy-fast setup times and many-small-hits-with-Inspiring-Presence synergy.

(For the curious, the games were in Atlantis, Mme. Mittermeier's, Time Cataclysm, Freedom Tower, and Insula Primalis, respectively. Longest game was Dreamer at 8 rounds due to her finding both Dark Heroes and both Granite Oni in the first two or three rounds. Shortest was Iron Legacy at 2 rounds.)

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Yesss! Someone else's name in the Unstable Kismet column! XD

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked: Fixed. Thanks.

posts.name: thrawn.kol
posts.cooked: F5 took down Kaargra Warfang at the Block. As expected, Seeker-Death Caller-Living Weapon F5 Tachyon is a monster. Won by using Death Caller to execute Kaargra through Unbreakable after pushing my Favor into the low 20s.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: That's a combo I'll have to remember. Heck, just Seeker would own with her. :D

posts.name: thrawn.kol
posts.cooked:
Yup. Getting that combo definitely made up for never getting an opportunity to claim Chaos Lord.

The F5 brought down Advanced Infinitor at the Enclave of the Endlings. Might have been over a round sooner if the Endlings didn't "helpfully" remove Manifestations to keep Infinitor from flipping -- twice. Once he flipped, however, he went from 55 to 0 in one round.

Next, Advanced Heroic Infinitor stood trial at the Celestial Tribunal. Despite a starting layout full of Miscreations, the F5 were able to wear everything down just in time for a third-round Whispers of Oblivion to clear the courtroom.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Another Villains game: Citizens Hammer & Anvil, Bugbear, Greazer and La Capitan vs. Parse, Young Legacy, KNYFE Rogue Agent and DW Expatriette. My stand-by strategy of using the Final Wasteland to my advantage mostly turned against me in the latter half of the game. (There's nothing quite like playing a game with no Chiquito, though. :D)

posts.name: thrawn.kol
posts.cooked: F5 took down Advanced Deadline in Magmaria.

posts.name: thrawn.kol
posts.cooked: And the last one for my F5 World Tour – Progeny at Pike Industrial Complex. Complete curbstompy shutout due to good starting hands and being able to essentially skip two of Progeny's turns with Take Down and Hypersonic Assault, with a first-round Infrared Eyepiece to dictate his other plays. Should have done Advanced.

posts.name: thrawn.kol
posts.cooked:
Four straight wins for the XTREME Prime Wardens -- Blade at Court of Blood, Mad Bomber at Celestial Tribunal, Omnitron at Mme. Mittermeier's, and Omni-II at Omni-IV.

They definitely play a lot slower than the F5 did (and Haka, especially, feels like dead weight if he doesn't start with Taiaha, Mere, or a Cosmic Weapon from CC), but I'm starting to pick up their tricks -- Kill the Spirit leads to free 5-damage Sacrosanct Martyrs and focused-damage shenanigans from Fanatic's AoE One-Shots, Play With Madness ramps up fast when it's fueled by Rebel Yell, and so on.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Kill the Spirit is one of the most awesomely disgusting powers. Alongside Sacrosanct Martyr, you can do things like turn Chastise and Divine Focus into start-of-turn bombs. I mean, the card won't stay in play, but you weren't planning on keeping it around anyway, were ya?

And Play With Madness has taken Captain Cosmic from my least favorite hero to someone I always want to play. :D

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Not long ago, I played an "off the spreadsheet" team against Akash'Bhuta and lost horribly. Well, I got my revenge. :V Argent Adept, Chrono-Ranger, Visionary Unleashed and Sky-Scraper Extremist had a pretty easy time with her in the Time Cataclysm, no pun intended.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I normally have nothing better to do than sit around and play Sentinels all day, but today I've had really nothing better to do, so I played a few games on Steam and won half.

Captain Cosmic, Santa Guise, the Adamant Sentinels, Fanatic and Bunker won against AoG Spite in the Realm of Discord by sheer dumb luck. By which I mean Guise was going to die after his power use, but flipped Total Beefcake, which caused Spite to take himself out. Amazing.

Miss Information fell to Redeemer Fanatic, Horus Ra and Team Leader Tachyon in the Tomb of Anubis. It wasn't a good game for Tachyon, but pretty easy otherwise, as Miss Info games go.

La Capitan was taken out in the Time Cataclysm by DW Setback, DW Expatriette, Eternal Haka, Dark Visionary and Ra.

An easy game against Heroic Infinitor with Legacy, Unity, DW Setback, Expatriette and F6 Tempest in the Final Wasteland.

And lastly, the Dreamer was defeated by PW Argent Adept, KNYFE (she was supposed to be Rogue Agent, oops!) and the Adamant Sentinels in the MDP.

Also, I had a crazy game against Iron Legacy, where at the start of the first hero turn, everyone had one card in hand and three of the Sentinels were dead. XD We didn't last very long.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Played a little Vengeance this morning for REVENGE. Biomancer, Citizens Hammer & Anvil, Greazer Clutch, Miss Information and Plague Rat fell to... well, Plague Rat, but Omnitron-X, PW Tempest, Fanatic, Eternal Haka and Horus Ra were there in the Enclave of the Endlings. But seriously, I don't think the heroes landed the finishing blow on anyone but Plague Rat, that was all him. :B The victory lap game didn't go so hot.

Also, I filled in a couple slots for the weekly one-shot, since that was Vengeance and it needs all the help it can get.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
The one-shot today was fun and taught me how to use Omnitron-X in Vengeance, so I thought I'd do a few random games and try getting over my fear of using certain heroes in that style. I only won 3 out of 7 games though, so maybe those fears are founded. D:

First was a super-close game: Friction, Proletariat, Baron Blade, Fright Train and Ermine against Chrono-Ranger, Fanatic, Wraith, PW Argent Adept and Visionary in Silver Gulch. Fanatic was the last hero standing and was able to take out Fright Train with 1 HP left. Tense.

Next, Nightmist, F6 Tempest, Omnitron-X and the Adamant Sentinels defeated Proletariat, Friction, Ermine and Fright Train in Dok'Thorath. This game was won almost entirely by Nightmist. I mean, you think it's pretty amazing when Omnitron does 3-5 damage to everything via Defensive Blast? Nightmist followed it up with a 4/4 Oblivion. It hurt, but it was awesome.

The last game was the whole Vengeful Five against Parse, Naturalist, Unity, Scholar and Haka in the Realm of Discord. Nothing fun to report there, save that it was surprisingly easy, if not as easy as the previous game.

And, well, now I know Nightmist is worth bringing along, too. :)

posts.name: thrawn.kol
posts.cooked:
XPW took down Grand Warlord Voss in the Final Wasteland. In classic fashion, Haka used Rampage + Savage Mana to shred over a third of Voss' HP in one turn. MVP was probably Tempest, though, whose healing kept the whole team above 20 HP the entire game and later had Gene-Bound Shackles + Localized Hurricaine to slow-burn another third of Voss' HP through his front-side damage reduction.

… Should have done Advanced.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Pulled off an insane win against Kaargra Warfang with DW Fixer, Omnitron-U, DW Nightmist and Redeemer Fanatic. Fanatic flips Kaargra with Wrathful, bringing us into the environment turn 19-17. I won 20-18 because a lucky hit let Omnitron use Reactive Plating to kill the Villainous Weaponry. We would have lost after the next hit otherwise!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Wanted to get some cells filled in, so I ran the Vengeful Five against some Oblivaeon promos: Xtreme Argent, TLT (well, not Oblivaeon, but...), Fugue State Parse, Xtreme Fanatic and Termination Bunker. Not an easy game by any stretch, but Fanatic kicked lots of ass and no heroes died!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: I tried out Arcanist Lupus's thematic Vengeance matchup just now, and it turned out to be a really fun game! :D I used Adamant Sentinels and PW Haka in the name of maximizing cell fillage. The heroes were almost able to take out Miss Info before her first turn; she didn't make it to the first environment turn, at least. Medico was the only Sentinel representing by the end (thanks, Haka), but all the cards fell into the right places and it turned out for the best. :)

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Random game: Voss versus PW Haka, Horus Ra, Dark Conductor AA and the Scholar in the Final Wasteland. Easy win. Haka Haka'd for like 30, setting up Ra for a one-two burninate and Wrathful Gaze to finish the game. It's always satisfying to destroy the villain with Wrathful Gaze. :)

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: My last couple games against Akash'Bhuta haven't gone too well; this one was much better. The Xtreme Prime Wardens (with Completionist Guise playing the part of Fanatic) took her out in Freedom Tower, because goshdarnit, I wanted to win. :B It was a great game, with Captain Cosmic getting set way up and regularly doing 6-8 damage a turn, Argent Adept being all over the extra card plays, and Guise pulling out two rounds in a row of Blatant Barbarian. Tempest participated. :B

posts.name: Lord Flash Fire
posts.cooked:
Donner:

 

TakeWalker wrote:
Only one reportable game tonight 'cuz it was six-hero game night! :D Fun, if unbalanced. But, Prine Wardens Argent Adept, Xtreme Fanatic and Freedom Five Wraith were able to take Spite down in Rook City. I planned that game out and it worked, goshdarnit. :B  
"I love it when a plan comes together."

 

It is a pleasure to be able to quote lines to fit any ocassion

-Abraham Lincoln

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I noticed a bunch of villains who hadn't been defeated by any variant of certain heroes. Time to fix that! Lots of games, so I'll just list them.

The Vengeful Five fell to Guise, Expatriette, KNYFE, Setback and Tempest in the Final Wasteland. Guise has notoriously defeated almost no one in Vengeance style yet.

The Chairman was defeated by Nightmist, Setback, Guise and the Scholar in the Time Cataclysm.

Infinitor lost to the Adamant Sentinels, Wraith, Parse, Tachyon and DW Setback in the Final Wasteland. And nobody died!

Heroic Infinitor was helped by Young Legacy, DW Fixer, TLT, RC Wraith and Omnitron-X in Dok'Thorath. Less than 1200 matchups to go!

Iron Legacy was taken down by PW Argent Adept, Ra, the Sentinels and Sky-Scraper in Wagner Mars Base. It was a strangely easy game, and again, no one died (well, except like, two of the Sentinels).

Cosmotron was destroyed by EWAZ, Horus Ra, Tempest, F6 Unity and F6 Wraith in the Final Wasteland.

Then a few games with friends last night. Baron Blade gave a guided tour of the Block to Fused Captain Cosmic, Argent Adept, Fanatic and Legacy.

Deadline fell in the Time Cataclysm to Chrono-Ranger, Guise, Ra and Xtreme Fanatic.

Lastly, another win against Iron Legacy in the Final Wateland, with Ra, Wraith, Haka and Greatest Legacy. It was all about that last guy keeping us alive.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Played a game this morning to fill in Vengeance Plague Rat a little. Him, Biomancer, Miss Info, La Capitan and the Operative versus TN Unity, Nightmist, Guise, Fixer and EWAZ in the Enclave. It came down to Plague Rat versus Nightmist, and she was able to squeak out a win, mostly thanks to a timely Bloogo intervention.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Family game night was intense. The first game was TNAZ, Setting Sun Ra, Completionist Guise and Sky-Scraper Extremist against Baron Blade in the MDP. Not too wacky, but there were some Guise shenanigans.

No, I'm talking about the epic hour-long game against Voss in the Enclave of the Endlings. Fused Captain Cosmic, SS Ra, Visionary Unleashed and F5 Bunker have zero environment destruction, which meant about 5 straight rounds of Mass Levitation and a couple ridiculous Scorched Earths. To say nothing of Construct shenanigans, Slamara shenanigans... Voss was not much of an issue, is what I'm getting at here. :B

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Well, it seemed like a good idea. c.c La Capitan, Miss Info, Ambuscade, Greazer and Operative versus Xtreme Argent Adept, Xtreme Captain Cosmic, Omnitron-X, Visionary Unleashed and Setback in the Enclave of the Endlings. That was a long, intense game and I very nearly lost. D:

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Been a while since I sat down and played a bunch of Sentinels! :V First game was a rematch with Unstable Kismet: Mr. Fixer, Expatriette, Nightmist, Wraith and Xtreme Tempest took her down in the Time Cataclysm, though it wasn't easy.

Next, a fairly easy game against Miss Information, with Chrono-Ranger, KNYFE and Omnitron-X winning in the Mobile Defense Platform.

Mr. Fixer, Ra, DW Nightmist and KNYFE Rogue Agent had almost as easy a time with the Matriarch in the Block.

A super-easy game against Kaargra Warfang! By which I mean she didn't flip. PW Argent Adept, Chrono-Ranger, Ra and America's Greatest Legacy didn't hurt for things to punch in the Enclave of the Endlings, though!

The Dreamer was taken out by Chrono-Ranger, Nightmist and Dark Visionary in Freedom Tower, though she quite nearly took out Chrono-Ranger!

Progeny hadn't been beaten by any version of Unity yet, so Santa Guise, EoW Bunker, Expatriette and Tempest came to Silver Gulch to help her. And she actually won the day! Progeny, with a good 20 HP left in the final turn, plays Beginning of the End, nukes the sole Wagon, gets hit by that twice, then Cryo Bot twice, then Volatile Parts twice! It was awesome.

Lastly, it took me two tries (I spent the first game mining for Sucker Punches when I probably could have Flung him into Darkness instead), but EoW Bunker, Scholar, the Sentinels, SS Tachyon and Redeemer Fanatic beat Wager Master at his own game in the Final Wasteland.

In case anyone's wondering, the (solo) villains left with whole-hero gaps in their boxes are Kaargra Warfang (Captain Cosmic), Miss Information (Expatriette & Setback), and AoG Spite (KNYFE, Naturalist, Parse and Ra). There are too many for team villains to list. :B

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Not sure how I managed a win, but Nightmist, Guise, Chrono-Ranger, TN Unity and Sky-Scraper took out Greazer, Ambuscade, Bugbear, Hammer & Anvil and Sergeant Steel in the Enclave of the Endlings!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: I needed to test something in the digital game against Wager Master, and I ended up winning on the very first villain turn! This was the most upsetting victory I've ever had! >:| Well, it still counts for Dark Vis, Tachyon, Scholar of the Infinite, the Naturalist and PW Fanatic, so I'm writing it down.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Had time for a couple games this morning! First, a decently easy game against the Chairman, with Visionary Unleashed, Xtreme Tempest, Sky-Scraper Extremist, Setting Sun Ra and Completionist Guise in the Block. Sky-Scraper almost went down. But not quite.

Then a really easy game against Citizen Dawn in Freedom Tower, with F5 Legacy, Visionary Unleashed, DC Argent Adept, Setting Sun Ra and Xtreme Haka. I actually used the spreadsheet's random team generator for once and got something really solid! :D

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked: Hooray!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I missed my usual physical games last night, but not tonight! First, an easy game against Omnitron, with Chrono-Ranger, Ra, Fused Captain Cosmic and TN Unity in the Tomb of Anubis.

Then, an even easier game against Chokepoint, with Scholar, Super-Scientific Tachyon, Young Legacy and Guise in Rook City. Yeah, that's right: not even Rook City can make her difficult. :B

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked: Only time I've had a difficult game against Chokepoint, it was in Zhu Long's place, with regular Absolute Zero, Bunker and Unity. I won, but also got the 'win with 1 hero with 1 hp' achievement. I believe it came down to Unity.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Playing a team comprised only of Termi-Nation seems to be about the only thing that ups her difficulty. I mean, not even her advanced rules really do that. :B

posts.name: Blackfang108
posts.cooked:
Yeah.  the first time I played her on Advanced, I panicked when I saw how many cards she had after being flipped. 

The second time, I just trreated her as having DR1.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: Had a very intense Vengeance game: Ambuscade, Operative, Bugbear and Hammer & Anvil versus the Sentinels, Scholar of the Infinite, Hunted Naturalist and KNYFE in the Final Wasteland. A fairly long game, and we lost Dr. Medico, but despite everyone (except Writhe) having single-digit HP for most of the game, victory was achieved!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
The new Letters Page got me wanting to go a few rounds against Blade, then did some other stuff. It took two tries, but Kaargra Warfang was defeated by Chrono-Ranger, EWAZ, Hunted Naturalist, Tachyon and F6 Wraith. Of course, I messed up, that should have been Captain Cosmic, not Chrono-Ranger. >.< Oh well.

Then, a fun game against Miss Information. I can't say I've ever had one of those! But DW Expat, Setback, and Scholar of the Infinite took advantage of a good five rounds of Immutus and Bloogo to build, build, build, and Setback especially did 17 damage to her from his unlucky pool. It wasn't her day. :3

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I can't wait for Villains to come out digitally so I can find out all the ways I've been playing it wrong. :B Had a surprisingly easy game this morning against Sergeant Steel, Biomancer, Hammer & Anvil, Miss Info and the Operative, with PW Argent Adept, Parse, Omnitorn-U, DW Fixer and Xtreme Fanatic in the Block. That round of super-booster Chat damage was killer, but in the end, only Argent went down, Fanatic somehow holding out with 1 HP for rather a while. XD

Then, the easiest Spite game ever. Parse, Hunted Naturalist, KNYFE Rogue Agent, Ra and Sky-Scraper took him down in the MDP, and honestly I didn't even need Sky-Scraper. Rogue Agent KNYFE was able to get the Potential Sidekick off the bottom of his deck the first round, so I flipped the put-stuff-back drug at the end of his turn and kept him at one drug and 3 victims in the safe house for the whole game. That's how he's supposed to work! (It helped that he played almost nothing but more victims, too.)

Ooh, and thanks to those two games, Parse is now the first hero to defeat every villain in the game! :D

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
My quest to make sure every villain has been beaten by at least one variant of each hero is nearly at an end! All that's left is Bugbear!

This morning was Miss Info, Biomancer, Hammer & Anvil, Ambuscade and La Capitan versus Legacy, Captain Cosmic, Rook City Wraith, Absolute Zero and Eternal Haka in the Enclave of the Endlings. Incapped Biomancer and Citizen Hammer put a low-HP Absolute Zero in a bit of a pickle. Thank goodness for Cosmic Weapons, to say nothing of the disgusting Legacy/Wraith damage powerhouse.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Whoops, I lied, Kaargra Warfang was still on the list. :B But no more! It took me like six tries, but I finally beat her with Captain Cosmic, alongside Legacy, Haka, Horus Ra and the Scholar, in Megalopolis. It's always so nice when she doesn't flip.

Next, I beat the Chairman with DW Fixer, F6 Wraith, Santa Guise, PW Fanatic and PW Argent Adept in the Tomb of Anubis. It was a tough game, but no one went down, and Guise had a tremendous turn when he opened his presents and gave the Chairman the gift of about 25 damage in a single turn. :D

Lastly, a cool win against Iron Legacy in the Final Wasteland. PW Captain Cosmic, Argent Adept, DW Expat and Bunker all went down pretty quickly, but DW Nightmist weathered the onslaught, had some excellent support in her downed comrades, and was able to get Paul flipped, at which point the environment kicked the crap out of him, and ultimately took him out. Good stuff!

And now we're down below 1000 matchups left to play!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: All right, I got it done! Dark Visionary, Dark Conductor Argent Adept, Golem Unity, Setback and Rook City Wraith took out Miss Info, La Capitan, Greazer, the Operative and Bugbear in the Enclave of the Endlings. The hard part was just busting through Chiquito's card barrier! And DCAA only used an instrument once, on the very last round of the game. Boy is he useful for setting Unity up. And now Setback has beaten every villain in the game, too! :D
